params.name: data.client_operation_id
params.description: [Output Only] The value of requestId if you provided it in the request. Not present otherwise.

params.name: data.creation_timestamp
params.description: [Deprecated] This field is deprecated.

params.name: data.description
params.description: [Output Only] A textual description of the operation, which is set when the operation is created.

params.name: data.end_time
params.description: [Output Only] The time that this operation was completed. This value is in RFC3339 text format.

params.name: data.error
params.description: [Output Only] If errors are generated during processing of the operation, this field will be populated.

params.name: data.http_error_message
params.description: [Output Only] If the operation fails, this field contains the HTTP error message that was returned, such as NOT FOUND.

params.name: data.http_error_status_code
params.description: [Output Only] If the operation fails, this field contains the HTTP error status code that was returned. For example, a 404 means the resource was not found.

params.name: data.id
params.description: [Output Only] The unique identifier for the operation. This identifier is defined by the server.

params.name: data.insert_time
params.description: [Output Only] The time that this operation was requested. This value is in RFC3339 text format.

params.name: data.kind
params.description: [Output Only] Type of the resource. Always compute#operation for Operation resources.

params.name: data.name
params.description: [Output Only] Name of the operation.

params.name: data.operation_type
params.description: [Output Only] The type of operation, such as insert, update, or delete, and so on.

params.name: data.progress
params.description: [Output Only] An optional progress indicator that ranges from 0 to 100. There is no requirement that this be linear or support any granularity of operations. This should not be used to guess when the operation will be complete. This number should monotonically increase as the operation progresses.

params.name: data.region
params.description: [Output Only] The URL of the region where the operation resides. Only applicable when performing regional operations.

params.name: data.self_link
params.description: [Output Only] Server-defined URL for the resource.

params.name: data.start_time
params.description: [Output Only] The time that this operation was started by the server. This value is in RFC3339 text format.

params.name: data.status
params.description: [Output Only] The status of the operation, which can be one of the following: PENDING, RUNNING, or DONE.

params.name: data.status_message
params.description: [Output Only] An optional textual description of the current status of the operation.

params.name: data.target_id
params.description: [Output Only] The unique target ID, which identifies a specific incarnation of the target resource.

params.name: data.target_link
params.description: [Output Only] The URL of the resource that the operation modifies. For operations related to creating a snapshot, this points to the persistent disk that the snapshot was created from.

params.name: data.user
params.description: [Output Only] User who requested the operation, for example: user@example.com.

params.name: data.warnings
params.description: [Output Only] If warning messages are generated during processing of the operation, this field will be populated.

params.name: data.zone
params.description: [Output Only] The URL of the zone where the operation resides. Only applicable when performing per-zone operations.
